records.text: dusa rakihan mamaleng pialay ka riak la

senses.en: In the beginning both boys were fine.

records.text: pialay uhuni, isiza dali maluhusu a mudeken lia ka maxasahanay lia

senses.zh: 從現在開始有十天，已撿到一千個了
senses.en: From now on there are ten days left and we have picked one thousand ones.
